Shalini Soni, CMA

+91-9452041048 | mailto: shalinisonisoni68@gmail.com | https://linkedin.com/in/shalini- soni-27b09b66linkedin.com/in/shalusoni Hyderabad, India

Professional Summary

Results-driven Regulatory Reporting and Compliance Risk specialist with 9+ years of progressive experience in liquidity risk (LCR, NSFR, AMM), Basel III/IV, ALM, IRRBB, and multi-jurisdictional reporting (PRA, HKMA, EBA). Proven track record of delivering end-to-end regulatory compliance, conducting gap analyses, and driving process automation (Python) that reduced manual effort by 50%+. Skilled Business Analyst with expertise in stakeholder engagement, BRD development, and translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable system specifications. ECRL Wall of Fame Award recipient at Wells Fargo.

Core Competencies & Technical Skills

Regulatory Frameworks: LCR (DA/EBA), NSFR, AMM, Basel III/IV, IRRBB (EVE/NII), PRA, HKMA, EBA, GAAP/IFRS Compliance Risk Management: Risk identification & escalation, 1LOD/2LOD controls, regulatory breach monitoring, audit walkthroughs Business Analysis: BRD/FSD authoring, gap analysis, traceability matrices, process flow diagrams, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation Liquidity, ALM & IRRBB: LCR/NSFR calculation & reporting, EVE/NII sensitivity analysis, IRRBB stress testing, interest rate risk modelling, cash flow projection Automation & Analytics: Python (pandas, openpyxl), Advanced Excel (pivot tables, macros, VLOOKUP), Tableau, SQL Systems & Platforms: Oracle, Hyperion HFM, TrinTech Cadency, WINSAP, FOTC

Professional Experience

Wells Fargo Senior Consultant – Regulatory Reporting, Compliance Risk & Remediation

April 2024 – Present India (Offshore)

Prepare, review, and publish multi-jurisdictional regulatory liquidity reports including DA LCR, EBA LCR/AMM, NSFR, PRA, and HKMA, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery each reporting cycle.

Monitor regulatory compliance on an ongoing basis, report breaches promptly, and ensure adherence to applicable laws, internal policies, and Basel III/IV frameworks.

Identify, assess, and escalate compliance risks within liquidity reporting processes; collaborate with first and second lines of defence to implement mitigating controls and reduce exposure to regulatory breaches.

Lead Business Analysis (BA) for liquidity reporting enhancements: gather and document requirements from Treasury, Risk, and Finance stakeholders; produce BRDs, process flow diagrams, and traceability matrices to support system implementations and audit readiness.

Perform gap analysis between existing reporting processes and LCR/NSFR/AMM regulatory requirements, identifying data quality issues and process deficiencies, and producing detailed findings reports for remediation teams.

Collaborate with IT and data teams to translate business requirements into functional specifications, ensuring accurate data sourcing and calculation logic for liquidity metrics.

Facilitate working group sessions and cross-functional workshops with SMEs to validate reporting logic, align on methodology, and document agreed business rules and data definitions.

Track and manage change requests arising from regulatory updates (e.g., Basel III/IV amendments, PRA/EBA guideline changes); assess downstream impact on liquidity reporting templates and data flows.

Developed a Python-based automation tool to streamline manual liquidity data extraction and reconciliation workflows, reducing manual effort by 50%+ and cutting processing time from 60–90 minutes to under 30 minutes per reporting cycle.

Recipient of the ECRL Wall of Fame Award – the highest offshore team honour at Wells Fargo – recognising outstanding contribution to regulatory reporting and operational excellence.

CAPCO (A Wipro Company) | HSBC Operations Liquidity Risk, ALM, IRRBB & Reporting Consultant

January 2021 – February 2024 India (Offshore)

Led end-to-end liquidity reporting for HSBC across DA LCR, EBA LCR/AMM, NSFR, PRA, and HKMA frameworks, owning calculation, review, and sign-off for a multi-jurisdictional banking book.

Ensured Basel III compliance across ALM and liquidity risk frameworks; liaised with regulators and internal audit teams during review cycles and audit walkthroughs.

• Managed Asset Liability Management (ALM) activities to maintain a healthy balance between liquidity, profitability, and

risk across the banking book.

• IRRBB – Risk Measurement & Reporting: Supported production and review of Interest Rate Risk in the Banking

Book (IRRBB) reports under Basel IRRBB standards and EBA Guidelines (EBA/GL/2018/02); contributed to calculation and validation of Economic Value of Equity (EVE) and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivities across prescribed interest rate shock scenarios (parallel shifts, steepeners, flatteners, and short-rate shocks).

IRRBB – Gap Analysis & Regulatory Change: Performed gap analysis between existing IRRBB measurement frameworks and updated regulatory requirements (PRA SS31/15, EBA IRRBB guidelines); identified deficiencies in repricing gap schedules, model assumptions, and disclosure templates; produced findings reports for senior risk and ALM teams.

Conducted stress tests and scenario analyses to assess the impact of adverse market conditions on the bank’s financial position and liquidity ratios.

Performed cash flow shortfall and liquidity risk analysis through gap analysis, supporting daily liquidity and cash management including cash flow projections.

Utilised Oracle, WINSAP, Tableau, and Advanced Excel within a complex, data-intensive regulatory environment.

Genpact Senior Analyst – Financial Reporting & FP&A

September 2018 – January 2021 India

Prepared accurate and timely financial forecasts based on market trends, historical data, and business initiatives; monitored budget variances and provided detailed explanations for deviations.

Led annual budgeting processes in collaboration with cross-functional departments; developed and maintained management dashboards highlighting key financial and operational metrics.

Assisted in preparation of financial statements and statutory reports in compliance with GAAP/IFRS and organisational policies.

Drove process improvement, process mapping, standardisation, and automation initiatives, enhancing data quality, accuracy, and operational efficiency.

Accenture Financial Analyst – FP&A (US & UK Accounting)

September 2015 – August 2018 India

Performed month-end close activities including balance sheet and P&L reconciliations, fixed assets (capitalisation/disposal/transfer), prepayments, deferred income, accruals, and journal entries using SAP (FICO) and TrinTech Cadency.

Conducted trend analysis of financial statements; prepared year-end true-up depreciation entries and amortisation of intangibles.

Ran SAP data into BPC (Business Planning & Consolidation), validated outputs, and provided management reporting explanations for monthly consolidation sign-off with onsite Finance teams.

Managed Hyperion (HFM) consolidation submissions for US and UK entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with group accounting policies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) ICMAI – Institute of Cost Accountants of India

2012 India

Achieved 82nd All-India Rank in the Intermediate stage (ICWAI); cleared in a single attempt.

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Lucknow University • Secured 61%.

2010 Lucknow, India

Industrial Training (1 Year) Indian Oil Corporation – Cost & Management Trainee Key Achievements

2011 – 2012 India

Awards & Recognition

ECRL Wall of Fame Award – Wells Fargo’s highest offshore team honour for outstanding contribution to regulatory reporting and operational excellence.

Received multiple Client Recognition Star Awards across projects for consistent high performance and stakeholder satisfaction.

Impact & Innovation

Delivered Python automation solution reducing liquidity reporting manual effort by 50%+ (processing time cut from 60–90 minutes to under 30 minutes per cycle).

Led simultaneous multi-jurisdictional liquidity reporting at HSBC (DA LCR, EBA LCR/AMM, NSFR, PRA, and HKMA) as sole reporting owner.

Academic Excellence

• 82nd All-India Rank in ICWAI Intermediate examinations; cleared in a single attempt (2010). • Qualified for CFA Institute Women’s Scholarship, demonstrating commitment to continued professional

development.
